handoff_note: Released in v0.6.11 (2026-10-24) with the other phone-keyboard changes of the day. Android gap taps now also checked on the release emulator (emulator-5554, v0.6.11 release APK): taps between q|w, left of a, past p and below b typed qapb. Left for the person: a check on real phones (steps in alm human).
human_check_steps:
# Check: taps between keys type the nearest key (A04-tide827)

1. Put the current master on the phone: Android `scripts/build-android-app.sh install` with the phone on USB debugging; iPhone: build `iOS/` from Xcode onto the phone.
2. Open any text field with the Tatakikun keyboard.
3. Tap in the thin gap between q and w, a little nearer q: q is typed (before, nothing happened).
4. Tap the blank space left of a (and right of l): a (l) is typed.
5. Tap just past the right edge of p, near the screen edge, and just below the bottom row's keys: the nearest key answers.
6. Type fast with two thumbs: no letters lost. Press a key, slide far off it, lift: nothing is typed.
label: locally verified
title: Phone keyboards: a tap in the gap between keys types the nearest key, and keys on the outer edge answer taps a little beyond their edge
without_human_check: iOS: gap taps did nothing in the real keyboard (iOS gives an extension no touches on transparent parts); fixed and checked in the simulator's real keyboard
